# Crisis Starkiller Base defensive station.
#
# FOC 2.69 follows Kuat's proven fixed-design method:
# - not designable
# - no auto-generated default design
# - spawned by create_fleet/create_ship with a named global_ship_design
#
# This prevents the starbase auto-designer from replacing the requested
# TIE / SPAH-T / defence turbolaser / adaptive armor loadout.

foc_khan_starkiller_fixed_station = {
    is_space_object = yes
    max_speed = 0
    acceleration = 0
    rotation_speed = 0

    modifier = {
        ship_evasion_mult = -1
        ship_armor_add = @starhold_armor
        
        ship_weapon_range_mult = 2.0
    }

    max_hitpoints = @starhold_hp
    combat_size_multiplier = 80
    size_multiplier = 80
    fleet_slot_size = 2

    entity = "invisible_turret_entity"
    graphical_culture = no
    section_slots = {
        "core" = { locator = "root" }
    }

    num_target_locators = 0
    can_disable = yes
    uses_name_prefix = no
    takes_name_from_ship_design = yes
    can_be_inspected = yes

    class = shipclass_starbase
    construction_type = starbase_shipyard

    is_designable = no
    enable_default_design = no
    available_to_everyone = yes
    can_have_federation_design = no
    components_add_to_cost = no

    potential_construction = { always = no }
    possible_construction = { always = no }

    required_component_set = "power_core"
    required_component_set = "sensor_components"
    required_component_set = "combat_computers"

    formation_priority = 1
    icon_frame = 9
}
